name: 自然哲学
observation: 仪器与研究者像影视布景，天幕星光与室内材料缺少统一笔触。
direction: 电影式明暗与古典油画塑形；可见的方向性笔触、薄厚色层、软硬边缘，保留关键器物和人物活动。
preserveCue: 望远镜、星图、观测、手作实验与海岸城市，保留器物及原有时代细节。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit Image 1, the artwork itself. Produce ONE finished background image, no border, no panel, no caption. Preserve the whole composition, camera framing, subject identities, characteristic objects, cultural architecture, time period, main gestures and narrative relationships. This is a PAINTING-MEDIUM CORRECTION, not merely an aspect-ratio repair. The source is too photographic / CGI. Repaint forms themselves, do not retain photo materials under a texture overlay. Hand-painted strokes must be visible at ordinary viewing size: directional loaded brush marks, translucent glazing and dry scumbling, broken color, selective impasto highlights, and deliberate lost-and-found edges. Retain rich legible details in focal objects and faces, but group distant buildings/foliage into painterly masses. Cinematic composition and purposeful key light, layered depth, controlled cool-warm relationships. No universal orange sunset grading. Do not blur the entire image, do not add a canvas/noise filter, do not use photoreal skin, lens bokeh, plastic 3D or video-game sharpness. No new figures, no new conceptual diagrams, no large lettering or labels. Preserve meaningful small inscriptions already physically present on source objects. Keep coherent hands and anatomy. 16:9 landscape.
Intensity: Substantial repainting of ALL surfaces and figures into a recognizably hand-painted work; preserve content and layout, not photographic finish.
